title: bunny-perf-evidence/1 build line
description: The first line of a cargo xtask perf --evidence file: the identity of the two builds and the options of the run. Properties are listed in the order the writer emits them.

schema.description: The format identifier and version, carried by every line.

kind.description: The line kind: this is the build line.

base_ref.description: The --base revision as given, such as origin/main.

base_revision.description: The full commit SHA that base_ref resolved to; the report heading shows its first 12 digits.

candidate_revision.description: The full commit SHA of HEAD of the working tree that was measured.

candidate_dirty.description: Whether git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal printed anything before the build (a tracked change or an untracked, unignored file).

target.description: The --target triple as given, or the host triple from rustc -vV when none was given.

target_is_host.description: True when no --target was given and target is the host triple.

platform.description: The platform as the report heading names it.

rounds.description: Interleaved rounds per side, as the report heading states.

rustflags.description: The exact RUSTFLAGS both harness builds received, recorded as given.

harness_args.description: The arguments passed through to every harness run (--filter, --samples and their values), in order.

runner.description: The --runner command as given, or null when the harness ran directly.

max_regression.description: The --max-regression threshold in percent as given, or null when the gate was off.
